explanation.en: == compares values for equality; != checks that they differ. These comparisons return Booleans. A single = assigns a value and cannot replace == in a condition.
explanation.nl: == vergelijkt of waarden gelijk zijn; != controleert of ze verschillen. Deze vergelijkingen geven Booleans terug. Een enkele = wijst een waarde toe en vervangt == niet in een voorwaarde.

solution.main.py:
expected = 17
received = 12
matches = expected == received
differs = expected != received
print(matches, differs)

task.en: With expected = 17 and received = 12, set matches using == and differs using !=.
task.nl: Gebruik expected = 17 en received = 12. Bepaal matches met == en differs met !=.

checkpoints.check: matches is False and differs is True
